kicker: For the distraction dressed as an invitation
truth: They keep inviting you down. You keep building the wall.
prayer: Lord, I know the voice. It doesn't sound dangerous, it sounds friendly — a call, a scroll, a 'just real quick' that always lands the moment I sit down to do what You called me to do. Give me Nehemiah's same answer, every time it comes back dressed differently. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down.

save: Save this for the fourth time they ask
